brand.name: Super General
brand.notes: Super General (Super General Company LLC, Dubai UAE) AC codes — popular Gulf import in Pakistan (PakRef, Zahid Brothers, Gulf Electronics, Qasim/Yasir/Sohail/Opal; PK SKUs SGS*-PK / SGFS24i-PK). Official supergeneral.com/product-support = hotline/email only, no published error table, no LED blink maps. Sources: AirChill UAE technician guide (11 split), Accio FAQ (3), Fixya forum (2), Persian Fadaktahvieh 'Super general' OEM-shared table (16, medium — conflicts logged), floor-standing P10 video (1). Severe cross-source conflicts on E1/E3/E4/E5/F9 documented per-code. HARD EXCLUSION: Super General ≠ Super Asia (PK coolers) ≠ O General/Fujitsu General ≠ General Cool Dubai dealer ≠ SGW washing machines. No brand-badged service manual found.
